# Components

<!-- Generated by scripts/ui-catalog/docs.mjs from src/js/ui/catalog; do not edit. -->

Every component of the interface, as the UI catalogue declares it (plan G001, ADR 0081):
its hook, kind, label, the sentence the app shows, the state it reads or writes, and where
its trace says it comes from and is tested. Regenerate with
`node scripts/ui-catalog/docs.mjs`; `npm test` fails when this file and the catalogue differ.

157 declarations, 35 derived node faces, 16 visual components. By kind: action 20, choice 6, clip 1, edge 1, open 35, panel 34, param 11, readout 36, switch 9, transport 3, workspace 1.

## Visual components and the one frame

Rule `project.visual-components-framed`: each one renders inside the one frame
(`src/js/ui/catalog/frame.js`), which gives it full screen (the Fullscreen API, or a fixed
overlay inside the safe area where an element has none), Escape and Back to leave it, a
size class from its own box (`phone` under 480 px, `small` under 1024 px, `large`), and,
when it declares full-screen controls, a menu (`<hook>.frame`) listing every option.

| Hook | Label | Frame hooks | Full-screen controls | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `additive` | Additive Synthesis | `additive.fullscreen` | none | Draws the amplitudes of the first ten harmonics as editable bars. |
| `analysis` | Signal analysis | `analysis.fullscreen`, `analysis.frame` | `analysis.fsPause` (switch, Pause animation): Pauses or resumes the animation of the analysis views while they fill the screen. | Draws the waveform, spectrum, spectrogram, harmonics and signal path of the output, one tab at a time. |
| `bio` | Bioacoustics | `bio.fullscreen` | none | Draws the approximate hearing ranges of species against the tone that plays. |
| `envelope` | Envelope (ADSR) | `envelope.fullscreen` | none | Draws the attack, decay, sustain and release envelope as a draggable graph. |
| `exp.compareView` | Compare | `exp.compareView.fullscreen` | none | Draws the overlay, difference and impulse responses of two compared experiments. |
| `exp.detailView` | Experiment | `exp.detailView.fullscreen` | none | Draws the frequency response of the saved experiment that is open. |
| `filter.lab` | Filter Lab | `filter.lab.fullscreen` | none | Draws the magnitude response of the filter the engine computes, beside its controls. |
| `keyboard` | Keyboard | `keyboard.fullscreen` | none | Holds the computer-keyboard controls and the on-screen keys of the view in sight. |
| `measure.resultView` | Measurement result | `measure.resultView.fullscreen` | none | Draws the measured frequency response, impulse response and RTA of the run shown. |
| `mic` | Microphone Analyzer | `mic.fullscreen` | none | Draws the microphone spectrum against the generator target, with its peaks. |
| `peeper` | Peeper | `peeper.fullscreen`, `peeper.frame` | `peeper.fsWindow` (choice, Window): Steps the time window the peeper draws through 5, 10, 20 and 50 ms. | Watches one tap point of the signal at any time, on every page, like a small scope. |
| `phase` | Phase & Stereo | `phase.fullscreen` | none | Draws signals A and B and their Lissajous figure. |
| `seq.panel` | Pattern Sequencer | `seq.panel.fullscreen` | none | Draws the pattern timeline with its ruler, blocks and playhead. |
| `spectrogram` | Spectrogram | `spectrogram.fullscreen` | none | Scrolls the live spectrogram of the output on the Analyzer, time against frequency. |
| `studio.compact` | Studio | `studio.compact.fullscreen` | none | Shows the open Studio document beside the instrument, with its own transport. |
| `synth.bay` | Patch bay | `synth.bay.fullscreen` | none | Groups the jacks, the connect list and the cables of the voice. |

## Derived node faces

One per node type of the Studio node registry, derived and never declared by hand.

| Hook | Label | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `studio.node.oscillator` | Oscillator | A periodic tone at a requested digital frequency. |
| `studio.node.noise` | Noise | Deterministic white, pink or brown noise from a seeded generator. |
| `studio.node.sweep` | Sweep | A frequency sweep. Its reference output is the exact digital stimulus for transfer measurements. |
| `studio.node.sequence` | Sequence | Plays the pattern clips of its timeline track with the existing sequencer. |
| `studio.node.microphone` | Microphone | The browser microphone input, for analysis and measurement only. Nothing is uploaded; a measurement capture stays in this browser. |
| `studio.node.vco` | VCO | An oscillator at A4 × 2^octave of its scale (8' = 440 Hz), driven by a pitch input in octaves, so a Keys pitch tracks it exactly. |
| `studio.node.additive-voice` | Additive engine | Additive synthesis: a sum of harmonics, the drawbars H1-H12 (linear amplitude, relative), or the series of a saw, square or triangle, with a tilt in dB per octave. |
| `studio.node.fm-voice` | FM engine | FM synthesis with 2 to 4 sine operators routed by an algorithm table: modulators drive the frequency of their targets, carriers sum into the voice. |
| `studio.node.am-voice` | AM/ring engine | Ring and amplitude modulation: a carrier at the note times a modulator at Ratio × the note. |
| `studio.node.wavetable-voice` | Wavetable engine | Wavetable synthesis: four band-limited tables per bank, crossfaded by Morph (0 to 3, modulatable at audio rate). The Hard sync bank holds saws hard-synced at 1, 2, 3 and 4.5 times the note. |
| `studio.node.perc-voice` | Percussion engine | A percussion kit on the keys: kick (a sine with a falling pitch and a noise click), snare (two tones and noise), clap (noise with three short bursts), three toms, hats (six square oscillators at fixed non-harmonic ratios through a high-pass) and a noise hit. |
| `studio.node.lfo` | LFO | A modulation oscillator, from slow sweeps to audio rate (FM, AM). The rate slider spans 0.01-100 Hz; an audio rate is typed. |
| `studio.node.envelope` | Envelope | An ADSR envelope applied to the audio passing through it. |
| `studio.node.random` | Random | Seeded random values, a new one per period or per clock trigger. |
| `studio.node.step-modulator` | Step Modulator | Steps through a list of values, one per period or per clock trigger. |
| `studio.node.macro` | Macro | One control value, 0 to 1, that drives several parameters from one place. |
| `studio.node.keys` | Keys | The note source of a monophonic voice: the on-screen and computer keyboard and MIDI notes play it while the Synth is armed. |
| `studio.node.gain` | Gain | Scales the audio level (linear gain; 1 = unchanged). |
| `studio.node.filter` | Filter | A biquad filter (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, peaking, low-shelf, high-shelf, all-pass) with click-free bypass. |
| `studio.node.pan` | Pan | Places a mono signal in the stereo field (equal-power law). |
| `studio.node.stereo-split` | Stereo Split | Routes two mono sources to the stereo channels: split, panned or mono. |
| `studio.node.mixer` | Mixer | Sums up to four audio signals, each with its own level. |
| `studio.node.drive` | Drive | Soft saturation: a tanh curve on a wave shaper with 4× oversampling, then a trim and a hard clip. |
| `studio.node.ring` | Ring | Multiplies two audio signals: ring c·m (sum and difference frequencies, the carrier suppressed), or AM c·(1 − d/2 + d/2·m) (the carrier kept, sidebands at d/2). |
| `studio.node.scope` | Scope | Shows the waveform of the tapped signal. |
| `studio.node.spectrum` | Spectrum | Shows the magnitude spectrum of the tapped signal. |
| `studio.node.spectrogram` | Spectrogram | Shows how the spectrum of the tapped signal changes over time. |
| `studio.node.meter` | Meter | Shows the level of the tapped signal. |
| `studio.node.rta` | RTA | Band levels in octave or one-third-octave bands (estimated, FFT-based). |
| `studio.node.master` | Master Output | The single output of the Studio, through the OSCILLA limiter and output ceiling. |
| `studio.node.recorder` | Recorder/Export | Exports the tapped signal as a WAV file rendered offline. |
| `studio.node.capture` | Capture | Captures a signal of the graph as PCM for measurement (a digital loopback). |
| `studio.node.calibration` | Calibration | Applies a stored frequency-response calibration profile to the observed signal. |
| `studio.node.transfer-analyzer` | Transfer Analyzer | Computes the transfer function H(f) from the digital reference and the capture. |
| `studio.node.measurement-result` | Measurement Result | Shows a measurement result and stores it in the experiment. |
